name: Copilot Studio Guardrails Coach
description: Harden and manually red-team a Copilot Studio or Scout agent with no code - walk the full Foundry Control Plane guardrail checklist, run an interactive adversarial test with benign canaries in the Test pane, and generate a fixed HTML/PDF security report with a per-control results table and a deploy / do-not-deploy verdict. Self-evolving guardrail catalog.
author: Swarup Mishra
